provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Pagan: Fate of Roanoke rules (Kosmos / Capstone, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Decide who plays the Witch and who plays the Hunter
Witch: 3 Action pawns (2 regular, 1 Familiar), Witch board, green Influence disc
Hunter: 3 Action pawns, Hunter board, red Influence disc
3-part village board in the middle (1st, 2nd, 3rd); Enchantment board beside it
The 9 villagers on their matching spaces (symbol and colour)
Shuffle the 9 Suspects; the Witch secretly draws 1: the true Witch
Clues, Evidence, Secrets and Favors in the general supply
Each player draws 3 cards and sets their Influence disc to 2
steps.note: First game: a player aid next to each board

steps.text: First turn: the Witch has only 2 regular pawns, both on villagers of the same faction
A villager is ready only with no Action pawn on it
Upkeep: discard down to 7 cards; Hunter pays Ally upkeep in Influence
The Witch takes the first turn
